## 1、**DC06PE06**判别两棵二叉树是否相似。

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
int dfs(BiTree a, BiTree b){
    if ((a==NULL&&b!=NULL)||(a!=NULL&&b==NULL)) {
        return -1;
    }
    if (a==NULL&&b==NULL) {
        return 1;
    }
    int a1=dfs(a->lchild,b->lchild);
    if (a1==-1) {
        return -1;
    }
    int b1=dfs(a->rchild,b->rchild);
    if (b1==-1) {
        return -1;
    }
    return 1;
}

Status Similar(BiTree T1, BiTree T2) 
{   // Add your code here
int a=dfs(T1,T2);
if (a==-1) {
    return FALSE;
}

return TRUE;

}

```

## 4、**DC06PE21**利用栈及其基本操作，编写二叉树的非递归的先序遍历算法。

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
void PreOrder(BiTree T, Status (*visit)(TElemType))
{   // Add your code here
    if (T == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    Stack s;
    InitStack(s);
    Push(s, T);  

    while (!StackEmpty(s)) {
        BiTree node ; 
        Pop(s,node);  
        visit(node->data);

        if (node->rchild != NULL) {
            Push(s, node->rchild);  
        }
        if (node->lchild != NULL) {
            Push(s, node->lchild);  
        }
    }
}
```

## 5、**DC06PE30**判别给定两棵二叉树是否同构

```
#include "allinclude.h"
bool dfs(BiTree a, BiTree b){
        if (a == NULL && b == NULL) {
        return true;
    }
    
    if (a == NULL || b == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    if (a->data != b->data) {
        return false;
    }
    return (dfs(a->lchild, b->lchild) && dfs(a->rchild, b->rchild)) ||
           (dfs(a->lchild, b->rchild) && dfs(a->rchild, b->lchild));
}

}
return FALSE;


}
```

## 6、**DC06PE32**利用栈的基本操作，写出后序遍历的非递归算法

```
#include "allinclude.h"
void PostOrder(BiTree bt, void (*visit)(TElemType))
/* 使用栈，非递归后序遍历二叉树bt，    */
/* 对每个结点的元素域data调用函数visit */
{    // Add your code here
TElemType c[100];
int len=0;
if (bt == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    SqStack2 s;
    SElemType *res = (SElemType *)malloc(sizeof(SElemType));
    res->ptr=bt;
    InitStack_Sq2(s);
    Push_Sq2(s, *res);  

    while (!StackEmpty_Sq2(s)) {
        SElemType *res2 = (SElemType *)malloc(sizeof(SElemType));
        SElemType *res3 = (SElemType *)malloc(sizeof(SElemType));
        SElemType *res4 = (SElemType *)malloc(sizeof(SElemType));

        Pop_Sq2(s, *res2);  
        c[len++]=res2->ptr->data;

        if (res2->ptr->lchild != NULL) {
            res3->ptr=res2->ptr->lchild;
            Push_Sq2(s, *res3);  
        }
        if (res2->ptr->rchild != NULL) {
            res4->ptr=res2->ptr->rchild;
            Push_Sq2(s,*res4);
        }
    }
    for (int i = len-1; i >=0; i--) {
        visit(c[i]);
    }
}
```

## 8、**DC06PE34**不使用栈，写出三叉链表的后序遍历的非递归算法

```
#include "allinclude.h"
void PostOrder(TriTree bt, void (*visit)(TElemType))
/* 不使用栈，非递归后序遍历二叉树bt，  */
/* 对每个结点的元素域data调用函数visit */
{  // Add your code here
if (bt==NULL) {
    return;
}
TriTree p=bt;

while (p!=NULL) {
    if (p->mark==0) {
        if (p->lchild!=NULL&&p->lchild->mark==0) {
            p=p->lchild;
        }else if (p->rchild!=NULL&&p->rchild->mark==0) {
            p=p->rchild;
        }else {
            visit(p->data);
            p->mark=1;
            p=p->parent;
        }
    }else {
        p=p->parent;
    }



}


}

```

## 10、**DC06PE36**求以二叉链表存储的完全二叉树的最后一层的最后一个结点

```
#include "allinclude.h"
int depth(BiTree a){
int depth=0;
BiTree begin=a;
while (begin!=NULL) {
    depth++;
    begin=begin->lchild;
}

return depth;
}


BiTNode* getLastNode(BiTree T)
/* 求完全二叉树的最后一层的最后一个结点 */
{   // Add your code here
if (T==NULL) {
    return NULL;
}
BiTree cur=T;

while (true) {
    if (cur->lchild==NULL&&cur->rchild==NULL) {
        return cur;
    }
    int left=depth(cur->lchild);
    int right=depth(cur->rchild);
    if (left>right) {
        cur=cur->lchild;
    }else {
        cur=cur->rchild;
    }
}

}
```

## 13、**DC06PE44**编写递归算法，求二叉树中以元素值为x的结点为根的子树的深度

```
#include "allinclude.h"
BiTree dfs(BiTree T, TElemType x){
    if (T==NULL) {
        return NULL;
    }

    if (T->data==x) {
        return T;
    }
    BiTree lx=dfs(T->lchild,x);
    if (lx!=NULL) {
        return lx;
    }
    BiTree rx=dfs(T->rchild,x);
    if (rx!=NULL) {
        return rx;
    }
    return NULL;
}
int depthTree(BiTree a){
    if (a==NULL) {
        return 0;
    }
    int lx=depthTree(a->lchild);
    int rx=depthTree(a->rchild);
    return 1+(lx>rx?lx:rx);

}
int Depthx(BiTree T, TElemType x)
{  // Add your code here

    BiTree res=dfs(T,x);

    if (res!=NULL) {
        int result=depthTree(res);
        return result;
    }
    return 0;

}
```

## 14、**DC06PE46**复制一棵二叉树（非递归，利用队列）

```
#include "allinclude.h"
void CopyBiTree(BiTree T, BiTree &TT)
{  // Add your code here
    if (T==NULL) {
        return;
    }
    TT = (BiTree)malloc(sizeof(BiTNode));
    TT->data=T->data;
    TT->lchild=NULL;
    TT->rchild=NULL;
    LQueue res;
    InitQueue_LQ(res);
    EnQueue_LQ(res,T);
    EnQueue_LQ(res,TT);

    while (!QueueEmpty_LQ(res)) {
        BiTree orig,copy;
        DeQueue_LQ(res,orig);
        DeQueue_LQ(res,copy);

        if (orig->lchild != NULL) {
            copy->lchild = (BiTree)malloc(sizeof(BiTNode));
            copy->lchild->data = orig->lchild->data;
            copy->lchild->lchild = NULL;
            copy->lchild->rchild = NULL;
            EnQueue_LQ(res, orig->lchild); 
            EnQueue_LQ(res, copy->lchild); 
        }

       
        if (orig->rchild != NULL) {
            copy->rchild = (BiTree)malloc(sizeof(BiTNode));
            copy->rchild->data = orig->rchild->data;
            copy->rchild->lchild = NULL;
            copy->rchild->rchild = NULL;
            EnQueue_LQ(res, orig->rchild); 
            EnQueue_LQ(res, copy->rchild); 
        }



    }
    



}
```

## 15、**DC06PE47**利用队列的基本操作，编写按层次顺序(同一层自左至右)遍历二叉树的算法

```
#include "allinclude.h"
void LevelOrder(BiTree bt, char *ss)
{  // Add your code here
if (bt==NULL) {
    return;
}

    BiTree head=bt;
    LQueue res;
    InitQueue_LQ(res);
    EnQueue_LQ(res,head);
    char s[100];
    int len=0;

    while (!QueueEmpty_LQ(res)) {
        BiTree temp;
        DeQueue_LQ(res,temp);

        s[len++]=temp->data;

        if (temp->lchild!=NULL) {
            EnQueue_LQ(res,temp->lchild);
        }
        if (temp->rchild) {
            EnQueue_LQ(res,temp->rchild);
        }
        
    }
    s[len]='\0';
    strcat(ss,s);
    return;
}
```

## 16、**DC06PE48**已知二叉树中的两个结点，求距离它们最近的共同祖先

```

BiTree res;
int dfs(BiTree a, TElemType x, TElemType y){
    if (a==NULL) {
        return 0;
    }

    int la=dfs(a->lchild,x,y);
    
    int ra=dfs(a->rchild,x,y);

    if ((la==1&&ra==2)||(la==2&&ra==1)) {
        res=a;
        return 3;
    }else if (la==3||ra==3) {
        return 3;
    }else if (la==4||ra==4) {
        res=a;
        return 3;
    }

    if (a->data==x) {
        if (la==2||ra==2) {
            return 4;
        }
            return 1;
    }else {
        if (la==2||ra==2) {
            return 2;
        }
    }
    if (a->data==y) {
        if (la==1||ra==1) {
            return 4;
        }
            return 2;
    }else {
        if (la==1||ra==1) {
            return 1;
        }
    }
    
    return 0;
}
```

## 17、**DC06PE49**编写算法判别给定二叉树是否为完全二叉树

```
#include "allinclude.h"
Status CompleteBiTree(BiTree bt)
{  // Add your code here
if (bt==NULL) {
     return TRUE;
}
BiTree head=bt;
LQueue res;
InitQueue_LQ(res);
EnQueue_LQ(res,head);
int sign=1,len=0;
int now=0;

    // if ((head->lchild!=NULL&&head->rchild!=NULL)
    // ||(head->lchild==NULL&&head->rchild==NULL)) {
    //     sign=1;
    // }else if (head->lchild!=NULL&&head->rchild==NULL) {
    //     return TRUE;
    // }else{
    //     return FALSE;
    // }

while (!QueueEmpty_LQ(res)) {
    BiTree temp;
    DeQueue_LQ(res,temp);

    if (temp->lchild!=NULL&&temp->rchild!=NULL) {
        now=1;
        if (now!=sign) {
             return FALSE;
        }
        sign=1;
        EnQueue_LQ(res,temp->lchild);

}
```

## 19、**DC06PE67**在二叉查找树中插入一个元素

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
Status InsertBST_I(BSTree &T, TElemType k) 
{    // Add your code here
if (T==NULL) {
    T = (BSTree)malloc(sizeof(struct BSTNode));  
    T->data = k;
    T->lchild = NULL;  
    T->rchild = NULL;
    return OK;
}

BSTree head=T;
BSTree prev=NULL;
BSTree target=(BSTree)malloc(sizeof(BSTree));
target->data=k;
target->lchild=NULL;
target->rchild=NULL;
while (true) {
    if (head->data.key<k.key) {
        prev=head;
        head=head->rchild;
        if (head==NULL) {
            prev->rchild=target;
            return OK;
        }
    }else if (head->data.key>k.key) {
        prev=head;
        head=head->lchild;
        if (head==NULL) {
            prev->lchild=target;
            return OK;
        }
    }else {
        return ERROR;
    }




}

}
```

## 20、**DC06PE69**将二叉树以字符串形式输出

```
        return ;
    }
    res[len++]=a->data;
    if (a->lchild!=NULL||a->rchild!=NULL) {
        res[len++]='(';
    }
    

    if (a->lchild!=NULL&&a->rchild!=NULL) {
        dfs(a->lchild);
        res[len++]=',';
        dfs(a->rchild);
    }else if (a->lchild!=NULL&&a->rchild==NULL) {
        
        dfs(a->lchild);
        res[len++]=',';
        res[len++]='#';
    }else if (a->lchild==NULL&&a->rchild!=NULL) {
        res[len++]='#';
        res[len++]=',';
        dfs(a->rchild);
    }
    
    if (a->lchild!=NULL||a->rchild!=NULL) {
        res[len++]=')';
    }
}
```

## 21、**DC06PE75**求二叉排序树中第k小的结点的位置

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
int number;
BSTNode * res;
int dfs(BSTree a){
    if (a==NULL) {
        return 0;
    }
    

    int la=dfs(a->lchild);
    if (la==1) {
        return 1;
    }
    number--;
    if (number==0) {
        res=a;
        return 1;
    }
    int ra=dfs(a->rchild);
    if (ra==1) {
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

BSTNode *Ranking(BSTree T, int k) 
{    // Add your code here

if (T==NULL||k<=0) {
    return NULL;
}
res=NULL;
number=k;
dfs(T->lchild);
if (res!=NULL) {
    return res;
}
number--;
if (number==0) {
    return T;
}
dfs(T->rchild);
if (res!=NULL) {
    return res;
}

}
```

## 23、**DC06PE82**平衡二叉排序树的右平衡处理

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
int updateBF(BBSTree a) {
       
    if (a==NULL) {
        return 0;
    }
    int lh=updateBF(a->lchild);
    int rh=updateBF(a->rchild);
    a->bf=lh-rh;

    return 1+(lh>rh?lh:rh);
}
void dfs(BBSTree &a){
    if (a==NULL) {
        return;
    }
    dfs(a->lchild);
    
    dfs(a->rchild);

    updateBF(a);
    // printf("%d%c ",a->bf,a->key);

    if (a->bf==-2) {
        printf("%d%c ",a->bf,a->key);
        if (a->rchild==NULL) {
            return;
        }
        BBSTree right=a->rchild;
        if (right->bf<=0) {
            printf("1");
            L_Rotate(a);
        }else {
            printf("2");
            R_Rotate(a->rchild);
            L_Rotate(a);
        } 
        updateBF(a);
    }
}

void RightBalance(BBSTree &T)

   dfs(T);
```
